high_level_description: The image shows the exterior of the Nelson Mandela Children's Hospital. The building has a modern architectural design with large glass windows and a flat roof supported by several concrete columns. The name "Nelson Mandela Children's Hospital" is prominently displayed in blue letters on the facade above the entrance. In front of the hospital, there are several people standing and interacting. Some appear to be taking photos or videos, as one person is holding a camera.
